The console was not built into this binary

You are reading the placeholder that ships instead of a 404.

The API this binary was told to call is {{.API}}.

To build the console into the binary:

  1. cd web && npm install && npm run build
  2. copy the output over internal/web/dist, keeping index.html
  3. make build

The API is already useful without a console: curl {{.API}}/openapi.json describes every route.
